subject: Missing PO issuance / allocation trace & line-item correction plan
messages:
From: Alice Mendez <alice.mendez@orbitcloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — PO number and spend cap clarification

Hi Jonas,

We uploaded the completed vendor onboarding packet via the portal yesterday (vendor: OrbitCloud, Tax ID: 98-7654321) but our onboarding specialist told us the PO number hasn’t been issued yet. Procurement here needs the PO and spend cap confirmed before we can start sending invoices.

Two specific asks:
- Can you confirm if a PO has been assigned? If so please share the PO number.
- We need the spend cap split across two line items: Core API credits (SKU: OC-API-100) and On-prem deployment support (SKU: OC-SUPPORT-1). The initial budget is $125k and our internal finance team requested $100k on OC-API-100 and $25k on OC-SUPPORT-1.

Also, a small correction: the onboarding CSV we uploaded had OC-API-100 quantity = 1, but we intended 100,000 unit tokens — curious whether that needs a line-item correction on your side. I’ve attached the portal confirmation (attachment stub).

Appreciate any guidance & who we should loop in on Redwood’s side to get this PO issued.

Thanks,
Alice Mendez
Senior Procurement Manager | OrbitCloud
procurement@orbitcloud.com

Attachment: portal-confirmation-stub.pdf (uploaded via vendor portal)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Mendez <alice.mendez@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO number and spend cap clarification

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads up and the details. Looping in Laura (Procurement Lead) and Ben (Finance Ops) to move this through.

Quick notes / immediate next steps from our side:
1) I don’t see a live PO for OrbitCloud in our system yet; procurement requests are queued. Laura, can you confirm current queue position and estimated time-to-issue?
2) We’ll need: vendor legal name, Tax ID (you provided 98-7654321 — good), W9 (if US-based) and a corrected SKU/quantity mapping for the API item so our ledger reflects the 100,000 token unit rather than 1. If you can attach the corrected SKU CSV I’ll pass it to Finance.
3) Ben — once PO is issued we’ll need a spend cap split set on two separate line items in the ledger (100k / 25k). Also flag a provisional cap hold until the PO number is live (so invoices don’t route to collections).

I attached a blank vendor_onboarding_form.pdf for completeness — please re-upload with the corrected quantity column in vendor-sku-list.csv if possible.

If it helps I can also open a Jira trace ticket for the allocation + line-item correction (PROC-1829) to track the state.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (stub)

From: Alice Mendez <alice.mendez@orbitcloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO number and spend cap clarification

Thanks Jonas — attaching the corrected files.

What I attached:
- signed-nda.pdf (executed NDA)
- vendor-sku-list.csv (corrected quantities: OC-API-100 quantity = 100000, OC-SUPPORT-1 quantity = 1)
- W9.pdf (tax form) — uploaded to the portal as well.

We are okay with the spend cap split of $100,000 (OC-API-100) and $25,000 (OC-SUPPORT-1). OrbitCloud would like the PO to allow for token overage billing (monthly), but capped per line item. If Redwood requires the overage policy to be reflected in the PO text we can accept the standard overage clause you shared earlier.

Please confirm next steps and expected PO number timeline.

Best,
Alice
procurement@orbitcloud.com

Attachments: signed-nda.pdf, vendor-sku-list.csv, W9.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alice Mendez <alice.mendez@orbitcloud.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO number and spend cap clarification

Alice / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the corrected CSV + W9. I opened Jira PROC-1829 and created a procurement request (internal ref: PR-2026-3891). Planned timeline:
- Today (within 24 hours): PR validation & ledger staging (I’ll confirm the exact PO text and overage clause).
- T+1 business day: Finance to issue PO number. Ben — can you create the provisional ledger entries and place a hold on invoice routing until the PO is final?

Immediate action items (who/what/when):
- Laura Bennett: validate PR-2026-3891, confirm PO text (including overage clause) — EOD today.
- Ben Carter: create provisional line items and cap holds in the billing ledger for OrbitCloud (100k / 25k) — by EOD tomorrow.
- Jonas Weber: once PO is issued, confirm the PO number with OrbitCloud and push the final onboarding packet to the vendor portal.

Benchmarks & acceptance criteria: PO must include two separate line items matching SKUs OC-API-100 and OC-SUPPORT-1, spend caps attached to each line item, and the overage clause noted as negotiated.

As a note for the ledger trace: there was a CSV import normalization issue that converted large quantities to 1 when commas were missing in the source system; I’m adding a step to our ingestion pipeline to validate SKU quantity > 1 for token-based SKUs to avoid future mis-maps. That should fix the recurring class of errors we’ve seen.

Alice — I’ll update this thread once the PO number is issued (or sooner if we need an interim PO placeholder).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference

--
Ben Carter
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
